## Personality

Jumpy, sharp-eyed and talkative to fight off the dark. She carries two lamps because one went out once.

## Story

Dagny keeps the gate on the night watch and has seen eyes in the dark beyond the road more often this year than last. She is braver than she thinks and has not noticed yet.
